text:
{
  "bugs": [
    {
      "id": "H1",
      "type": "missed null case",
      "description": "Removes the null-conditional operator when accessing the Identifier property, causing a NullReferenceException if the syntax is not a PropertyDeclarationSyntax.",
      "path": "src/MessagePack.SourceGenerator/CodeAnalysis/TypeCollector.cs",
      "old": "    private static Location? GetPropertyIdentifierLocation(IPropertySymbol property) => (property.DeclaringSyntaxReferences.FirstOrDefault()?.GetSyntax() as PropertyDeclarationSyntax)?.Identifier.GetLocation();",
      "new": "    private static Location? GetPropertyIdentifierLocation(IPropertySymbol property) => (property.DeclaringSyntaxReferences.FirstOrDefault()?.GetSyntax() as PropertyDeclarationSyntax).Identifier.GetLocation();",
      "detect_keywords": [
        "null reference",
        "null-conditional",
        "missing question mark"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "H2",
      "type": "logic inversion",
      "description": "Inverts the condition that checks if the diagnostic is located in the current compilation, causing valid diagnostics to be dropped and invalid ones to be reported.",
      "path": "src/MessagePack.SourceGenerator/CodeAnalysis/TypeCollector.cs",
      "old": "        if (diagnostic.Location.IsInSource && this.compilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(diagnostic.Location.SourceTree))\n        {\n            report(diagnostic);\n        }",
      "new": "        if (diagnostic.Location.IsInSource && !this.compilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(diagnostic.Location.SourceTree))\n        {\n            report(diagnostic);\n        }",
      "detect_keywords": [
        "logic inversion",
        "negation",
        "contains syntax tree"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "H3",
      "type": "wrong variable",
      "description": "Uses defineSource instead of usageSource when creating the usage compilation, which will cause the test to compile the wrong code.",
      "path": "tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/GenericsFormatterTests.cs",
      "old": "        Compilation usageCompilation = CreateCompilation(\"App\", usageSource, languageVersion, frameworkReferences.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).Append(definingAssembly));",
      "new": "        Compilation usageCompilation = CreateCompilation(\"App\", defineSource, languageVersion, frameworkReferences.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).Append(definingAssembly));",
      "detect_keywords": [
        "wrong variable",
        "definesource",
        "usagesource"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "H4",
      "type": "weakened test assertion",
      "description": "Changes the diagnostic severity check from >= Warning to > Warning, which would allow warnings to pass the test silently.",
      "path": "tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/GenericsFormatterTests.cs",
      "old": "        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning));",
      "new": "        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity > DiagnosticSeverity.Warning));",
      "detect_keywords": [
        "weakened assertion",
        "severity",
        "greater than"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "H5",
      "type": "false documentation claim",
      "description": "Falsely claims that members of a type defined in a referenced assembly are reported by the consuming project, contradicting the actual behavior implemented in the PR.",
      "path": "doc/analyzers/MsgPack004.md",
      "old": "Members of a type defined in a referenced assembly are reported by the project that defines that type, so an unattributed public member of such a type must be fixed in its defining project.",
      "new": "Members of a type defined in a referenced assembly are reported by the project that consumes that type, so an unattributed public member of such a type must be fixed in its consuming project.",
      "detect_keywords": [
        "documentation",
        "consumes",
        "consuming project"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "H6",
      "type": "silent exception swallow",
      "description": "Swallows the compilation failure by removing the exception throw and instead just logging to the console, which will cause downstream failures when trying to use the invalid image.",
      "path": "tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/GenericsFormatterTests.cs",
      "old": "        if (!emitResult.Success)\n        {\n            throw new InvalidOperationException(\"Failed to compile referenced assembly: \" + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        }",
      "new": "        if (!emitResult.Success)\n        {\n            Console.WriteLine(\"Failed to compile referenced assembly: \" + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        }",
      "detect_keywords": [
        "swallow",
        "exception",
        "console.writeline"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
